race.comment: FLYING IN THE WIND (13) gets the nod with a recent Lark Hill trial win. She's impressed at the trials and Pike sticks from her latest heat. She's a half to Listed winner and G2 placegetter Sail Session. Makes plenty of appeal in a maiden that looks to have a long tail. FILA MIA (4) resumes off a solid second in a Lark Hill trial and has shown enough in better exposed form to be a genuine danger if she returns switched on. EXTREME RULER (1) is the proven race-fit runner after finishing fifth at this track, beaten just under a length. Draws nicely this time for Brad Parnham who hops on board and he can feature with the fresh run under his belt. HAPPY DANCE (12) has been off the scene since a plain Ascot debut, but she was respected there. Carries no weight here and won't be far away. SHE'S DA VAL (9) comes right back in trip today off a disappointing fresh run and the booking of CJP suggests she's improved.
